summary: Direct a provider-neutral music-video workflow and render a bounded local shot timeline to a verified MP4.
requires: FFmpeg and FFprobe for render mode
A writable workspace containing the finished audio track and accepted local visual assets
Optional host-specific media generation or retrieval tools only when the requested production needs them
inputs: One local JSON project manifest with a finished audio path, output geometry, frame rate, and ordered shots
Local still images and/or video clips referenced from inside the manifest directory
outputs: A deterministic FFmpeg render plan in plan mode
A verified H.264/AAC MP4 in render mode
JSON media facts including duration, dimensions, byte length, and SHA-256 after rendering

enforced: At most 300 shots and 20 minutes of declared timeline
At most 120 seconds per shot and 60 frames per second
Even output dimensions with at most 3840 pixels per side and at most 3840x2160 total pixels
Each local input at most 2 GiB and all local inputs together at most 10 GiB
Manifest inputs must resolve inside the manifest directory
Existing output is not replaced unless --force is explicit
Audio duration and trimmed video-source durations are probed before rendering
operator: Keep paid generation, remote retrieval, account writes, and publishing inside the user's authorized task scope
Review generated or retrieved media rights, likenesses, and platform requirements before distribution
Watch the complete export before making an artistic-quality or audience-playback claim

stop_when: The requested MP4 is rendered and FFprobe verification succeeds
A required local asset, FFmpeg runtime, or compatible audio/timeline duration is absent
Another attempt would repeat a failed generation or render route without a concrete change
